name: verve
description: Strip AI tells from prose and put a human voice back, in British English, for Claude Code and Codex - a catalogue of tells across content, language, style, assistant artefacts and filler, four tone presets, three strength levels, and a scored exit gate where fidelity is a veto rather than an average. Runs in the conversation at no cost; an optional Undetectable AI engine is there if you want it.
